title: Problem
问题
html:
Direct LLM judges are costly, prompt-dependent, inflexible after a rubric change, and biased. These properties make large evaluation pipelines hard to audit and reproduce.

PAJAMA asks an LLM to synthesize executable judging programs instead of issuing a verdict directly. Programs can be stored, inspected, adapted, and run locally; weak supervision aggregates their noisy outputs.

直接 LLM judge 成本高、依赖 prompt、rubric 变更后不灵活且带偏差，使大型评测管线难以审计和复现。

PAJAMA 让 LLM 合成可执行判决程序，而非直接给 verdict。程序可存储、检查、调整并本地运行；弱监督汇总其带噪输出。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: PAJAMA (Program-As-a-Judge for Automated Model Assessment) moves judgment from repeated direct LLM calls into a panel of executable programs. An LLM synthesizes programs from distinct, code-expressible criteria; the programs run locally on answer candidates, and weak supervision combines their noisy judgments. This moves cost from each evaluated item to a reusable synthesis-and-review stage, while exposing the decision logic for inspection and testing. The framework is aimed at improving consistency and reducing bias and cost in repeated evaluation; it does not claim that programs eliminate every semantic judgment or replace human calibration.

PAJAMA（Program-As-a-Judge for Automated Model Assessment）把反复调用 LLM 直接判分，改为一组可执行程序构成的 judge panel。LLM 依据不同、可编码的判据合成程序；程序在候选答案上本地运行，再由弱监督合并其带噪判决。成本因而从每个被评样本转移到可复用的合成与审阅阶段，判决逻辑也能被检查和测试。框架目标是改善重复评测的一致性、偏差和成本；它不声称程序能消除所有语义判断，也不能替代人工校准。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Define six code-expressible criteria. 2. Prompt an LLM to synthesize diverse executable judge programs. 3. Run programs locally over answer pairs. 4. Use weak supervision to combine noisy, complementary program labels; optionally distill judgments into a model. Program correctness, sandboxing, criteria, and aggregation model are the critical reproducibility checks.
1. 定义六项可用代码表达的标准。2. 提示 LLM 合成多样可执行 judge 程序。3. 在回答对上本地运行程序。4. 用弱监督合并带噪、互补的程序标签，并可蒸馏判决到模型。程序正确性、沙箱、标准和聚合模型是关键复现检查。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Against a Qwen2.5-14B direct judge, PAJAMA improves judgment consistency by 15.83% and reduces biased responses by 23.7% on average. On RewardBench CHAT-HARD after distillation, it exceeds Prometheus by 2.19% and JudgeLM by 8.67%, at three orders of magnitude lower cost. These results support the method in the reported setup, not universal superiority of synthesized programs.
相较 Qwen2.5-14B 直接 judge，PAJAMA 平均提升判决一致性 15.83%，降低偏差回答 23.7%。蒸馏后在 RewardBench CHAT-HARD 上比 Prometheus 高 2.19%、比 JudgeLM 高 8.67%，成本低三个数量级。这支持报告设置中的方法，不证明合成程序普遍优于 LLM judge。

title: Novelty
新意
html: LLM judges usually regenerate a verdict for every item. PAJAMA moves the reusable artifact to executable judging logic and uses weak supervision to combine programs. Program synthesis and weak supervision are not new separately; the change is treating programs as the judge representation. Inspect generated criteria for semantic omissions before reuse.
LLM judge 通常为每个样本重新生成 verdict。PAJAMA 将可复用 artifact 移为可执行判决逻辑，并以弱监督组合程序。程序合成和弱监督各自并不新；变化在于把程序作为 judge 表示。复用前应检查生成标准是否遗漏语义要求。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Programs can be repetitive, noisy, or unable to encode nuanced semantic criteria. Weak supervision cannot repair a shared blind spot; audit program diversity, execution safety, and error cases before trusting aggregation.
程序可能重复、带噪，或无法编码细致语义标准。弱监督不能修复共同盲点；信任聚合前应审计程序多样性、执行安全和错误案例。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: If you repeatedly evaluate answer pairs under a stable rubric, synthesize and review a diverse program panel once, execute it in a sandbox, and aggregate its noisy outputs with weak supervision. Inputs are a rubric, code-expressible criteria, candidate pairs, and held-out human labels; the output is an auditable low-cost judge or distilled reward model. It is unsuitable when crucial criteria cannot be encoded or tested, or safe program execution is unavailable.
若需按稳定 rubric 反复评测答案对，可先合成并人工审阅一组多样程序，在沙箱中执行，再用弱监督聚合其带噪输出。输入为 rubric、可编码的判据、候选答案对及留出的人类标签；输出为可审计的低成本 judge 或蒸馏奖励模型。关键判据无法编码/测试，或无法安全执行程序时不宜采用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: executable programs replace per-item direct LLM judging.
  • Mechanism: six criteria induce diverse synthesized programs; weak supervision aggregates their labels.
  • Evidence anchor: against direct Qwen2.5-14B judging, the reported average is +15.83% consistency and -23.7% biased responses.
  • Reuse discipline: inspect programs, sandbox execution, and calibrate with human labels before deployment.
  • Artifact: the paper reports the workshop artifact; no verified public code or data URL is recorded here.

• 定位： 用可执行程序替代逐样本调用 LLM 直接判分。
  • 机制： 六项判据诱导合成多样程序，再由弱监督聚合标签。
  • 证据锚点： 相比直接使用 Qwen2.5-14B judge，平均一致性提高 15.83%，偏置回答降低 23.7%。
  • 复用纪律： 部署前审阅程序、在沙箱运行，并用人工标签校准。
  • 工件： 论文报告 workshop 工件；此处未记录经核验的公开代码或数据链接。
